text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I lay out a plan to encourage Tamamo Cross to eat more, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, I have the best chefs I know cook her a pair of delicious meals… but to no avail. It might be delicious, but Tamamo Cross doesn't have room in her stomach for the food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when she sees Gold City—her peer—striving to eat a balanced diet to support both her racing and modeling careers…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross has a change of heart. Although she'll have to start small, she sets out to eat better.
